# Somatic @ Stage 13 — Systematic Green

> developed 2026-07-24.

## Expression on this line

Somatic capacity at Order 12 is multi-paradigm somatic coordination: holding Western body
science, Eastern somatic traditions, indigenous body practices, and contemporary somatic
therapy in productive tension without collapsing to one. The defining capacity is that the
somatic thinker can hold multiple body paradigms simultaneously without needing to declare
a single winner.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL:** comfort holding multiple somatic paradigms as each partially valid.
- **UR:** the capacity to reason productively within multiple body frameworks.
- **LL:** a somatic culture that values pluralism — multiple body traditions coexisting and
  informing each other.
- **LR:** the institutional structures that support somatic pluralism.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction:** somatic relativism — holding so many paradigms that no coherent body
  practice emerges.
- **Dark allergy:** somatic lock — remaining committed to a single body tradition as the only
  legitimate lens.
- **Golden addiction:** claiming to have constructed a somatic metatheory (Stage 14) while
  actually just holding paradigms in pluralistic tension.
- **Golden allergy:** refusing to evaluate which somatic paradigms are more adequate.

## Diagnostic cues (Gross / Ground R&D)

- **Multi-paradigm somatic reasoning:** the thinker reasons productively within multiple body
  frameworks.
- **Cross-traditional somatic fluency:** the practitioner demonstrates competence across
  multiple body traditions.
- **Non-adjudicating comparison:** somatic paradigms are compared without declaring a single
  winner.

as cross-paradigmatic body knowing).
